name: valgent-workspace
description: Valgent Workspace - AI Code Validation & Claim Verification Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
